decision_basis: user_ratified_2026-10-22: views S/M/L = 60/120/240 words, contract cap 350

data.document_frequency_resource: all train records passing the filter; source text only

fact_inventory.tokenizer: lowercase [a-z][a-z0-9'-]* words; digit tokens normalized by removing commas and trailing periods
fact_inventory.phrase_rule: maximal runs of non-stopword tokens, sklearn english stop words, windows of 1 and 2 stems (Porter)

definition_A.eligibility: frequency >= 2 and occurs in >= 2 bins and train document frequency <= 0.20

fact_inventory.coverage: sum of salience weights of covered facts / sum of salience weights of inventory facts

constructors.oracle: greedy source-sentence selection maximizing newly covered salience per word under the budget, using the same definition being scored
constructors.lead: first complete source sentences within budget via the common delivery selector
constructors.uniform: evenly spaced source sentences within budget
constructors.random: seeded random source sentences within budget, source order
constructors.offtopic: lead sentences of a different train record within budget

tests.T0_inventory_size: at least 95% of sampled records have at least 50 inventory facts under definition A
tests.T1_known_groups: for each budget, share of records with oracle coverage > random coverage >= 0.95 and share with random coverage > offtopic coverage >= 0.95; lead versus uniform reported without direction
tests.T2_fact_deletion_dose_response: starting from oracle at L, remove 0/25/50/75 percent of sentences at random; mean coverage strictly decreasing over the four points and share of records non-increasing >= 0.95
tests.T3_unsupported_rate: mean unsupported rate of lead summaries <= 0.01; appending 0/1/3/5 off-topic sentences to oracle at M gives strictly increasing mean unsupported rate and share of records non-decreasing >= 0.90
tests.T4_invariance_and_monotonicity: repeating a lead summary twice or padding it with stop words changes coverage in 0 percent of records; coverage S <= M <= L holds in 100% of lead records, >= 90% of uniform records and >= 95% of oracle records
tests.T5_salience_sensitivity: median over lead, uniform and random of the Spearman correlation across records between definition A and definition B coverage at M >= 0.70
tests.T6_temporal_coverage_direction: share of records at M with uniform temporal coverage > lead temporal coverage >= 0.95

admission_rule: coverage and unsupported-content metrics pass this stage only if every test passes; any failure is recorded and the metric is not admitted as primary
not_run_in_this_stage: cross-family agreement with an entailment-based faithfulness metric (dependencies not approved)
